name: Palladous-Codex
description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by solar wind erosion patterns near the terminator.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Glass-bladed grasses chime across the plains whenever the wind finds its voice.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Whoever controls silicon controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
